Breeder_Origin_Institution: Corteva Agriscience Seeds Private Limited Hyderabad
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: High yield potential under irrigated conditions
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This variety is noted for its high yield potential which implies a degree of resilience to common biotic and abiotic stressors found in the irrigated ecosystems of Punjab and Haryana. Specific stress tolerance data is limited in public documents.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to blast and bacterial leaf blight
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This variety shows strong resistance to neck blast and moderate resistance to leaf blast and bacterial leaf blight which are significant diseases in its recommended growing regions.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: Hytech Seed India Pvt. Ltd. Hyderabad
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Tolerant to charcoal rot and fusarium stalk rot
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This maize hybrid exhibits tolerance to major stalk rot diseases which are critical for maintaining plant health and yield especially in the humid conditions of Eastern India.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Drought tolerant suitable for rainfed areas
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: As a millet this variety is inherently drought-tolerant and adapted to marginal lands with low water availability making it a climate-resilient crop.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Tolerant to downy mildew and drought conditions
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This pearl millet hybrid combines drought tolerance with resistance to downy mildew a major disease affecting this crop ensuring stable yields across diverse agro-climatic zones.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: ICAR- Central Soil Salinity Research Institute Karnal
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Tolerant to salinity and sodicity stress
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: Developed by the Central Soil Salinity Research Institute this variety is specifically bred for cultivation in salt-affected soils a significant abiotic stress in parts of North India.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: Chudhary Sarwan Kumar Himachal Pradesh Krishi Vishvavidyalaya Palampur
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to white rust and Alternaria blight
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This Gobhi Sarson variety is tailored for the hilly regions showing resistance to white rust and Alternaria blight which are common fungal diseases in these areas.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to rust and wilt diseases
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This linseed variety has genetic resistance to rust (Melampsora lini) and wilt (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. lini) two of the most devastating diseases for this crop.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to fusarium wilt
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This chickpea variety is resistant to Fusarium wilt a soil-borne fungal disease that is a major constraint to chickpea production in Southern India.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: National Institute of Plant Genome Research New Delhi
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Drought tolerant; Resistant to Fusarium wilt
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: ADVIKA is a product of marker-assisted breeding specifically introgressing genes for drought tolerance making it suitable for the rainfed and water-limited environments of Central India.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to wilt and root rot
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This chickpea variety has been developed for resistance to major soil-borne diseases like wilt and root rot which are prevalent in the North-Western plains.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to rust and wilt diseases
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This lentil variety is bred for resistance to rust and wilt ensuring stable yields in the major lentil-growing regions of Northern India.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: ICAR- Indian Institute of Pulses Research Kanpur
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to powdery mildew and rust
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This fieldpea variety shows strong resistance to powdery mildew and rust two significant fungal diseases that can cause major yield losses in Eastern India.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: G.B. Pant University of Agriculture and Technology Pantnagar
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to powdery mildew
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This variety is specifically resistant to powdery mildew a common disease in the humid conditions often found in the eastern parts of the country during the Rabi season.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: ICAR-Indian Institute of Pulses Research Kanpur
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: High yielding resistant to powdery mildew
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: Arpan combines high yield potential with robust resistance to powdery mildew making it a reliable choice for farmers in the Eastern Gangetic Plains.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to rust
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This fieldpea variety is specifically bred for resistance to rust a major constraint for this crop in the eastern region.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: ICAR- Indian Grassland and Fodder Research Institute Jhansi
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: High biomass suitable for multicut systems
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: While not a stress tolerance in the traditional sense its ability to regrow quickly after cutting (multicut) is a key resilience trait for fodder security.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Tolerant to sucking pests and bollworm complex
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This cotton variety has been developed to tolerate major insect pests including jassids aphids and the American bollworm reducing the need for chemical interventions.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Tolerant to leaf curl virus and sucking pests
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This variety exhibits tolerance to Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuV) and common sucking pests which are significant threats to cotton cultivation in Central India.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Tolerant to drought; Resistant to red rot disease
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This sugarcane variety is a 'wonder cane' known for its drought tolerance and strong resistance to red rot the most destructive disease of sugarcane.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Early maturing resistant to red rot
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This early-maturing variety combines high sugar content with resistance to red rot allowing for a more flexible harvesting schedule and reduced disease risk.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: High sugar content tolerant to water stress
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This variety is adapted to the water-limited conditions of Maharashtra and maintains high sucrose content even under moderate drought stress.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Tolerant to red rot and smut diseases
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: Developed for the subtropical zone this variety is resistant to the two most important fungal diseases in the region: red rot and smut.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: ICAR- Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research Lucknow
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Early maturing suitable for subtropical regions
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: Its early maturity allows it to escape some of the late-season abiotic stresses and it is bred for performance in the subtropical climate of North India.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: ICAR- Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research Lucknow
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: High cane yield resistant to red rot
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This variety combines high biomass with strong genetic resistance to red rot ensuring both high yield and crop security.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: ICAR- Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research Lucknow
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Tolerant to waterlogging and red rot
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This variety is specifically adapted to the conditions of Eastern India where waterlogging during monsoon is a major issue. It also has resistance to red rot.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: Dr. Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University Pusa
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Good ratooning ability resistant to red rot
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: Good ratooning ability is a key resilience trait as it allows for multiple harvests from a single planting. This variety also has resistance to red rot.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Tolerant to stem borer and leaf folder pests
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This rice variety has been bred for tolerance to major insect pests like the yellow stem borer and leaf folder reducing yield losses and the need for insecticides.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to blast and bacterial blight
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This biofortified variety not only provides higher protein but also has genetic resistance to blast and bacterial blight key diseases in the humid climate of Odisha.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Tolerant to drought and submergence
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This climate-smart rice variety is a major achievement offering tolerance to both drought (lack of water) and submergence (excess water) making it highly resilient to erratic weather.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to blast disease
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: While its primary value is its low glycemic index for health-conscious consumers its resistance to blast disease ensures that this quality trait is protected.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Tolerant to saline soils
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This variety is developed for coastal regions and areas with high soil salinity an abiotic stress that typically stunts the growth of most rice varieties.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences & Technology Srinagar
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Tolerant to root rot and bean common mosaic virus
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This Rajmash variety is adapted to the temperate conditions of Kashmir and is resistant to common viral and fungal diseases of the region.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Rice Research Hyderabad
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Bacterial blight resistance
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This rice variety possesses genes for resistance to bacterial blight one of the most serious diseases of rice in Asia.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Tolerant to bacterial blight and blast
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This variety combines tolerance to two of the most significant rice diseases making it a reliable choice for farmers across a wide range of states.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Moderately resistant to leaf blast sheath blight
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This variety offers a good level of field tolerance to major fungal diseases like blast and sheath blight which are common in the humid eastern states.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to yellow and brown rust
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This wheat variety contains genes for resistance to both yellow (stripe) rust and brown (leaf) rust which are major threats to wheat production in the southern peninsula.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to leaf and stem rusts
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This biofortified wheat variety is not only nutritious but also has strong genetic resistance to both leaf and stem rusts making it suitable for the central zone.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to multiple rusts heat tolerant
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This variety is a powerhouse combining biofortification with broad resistance to rusts and tolerance to heat stress making it highly resilient in water-limited environments.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to stem and leaf rust
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This durum wheat variety is specifically bred for rainfed conditions and has strong resistance to the major rust diseases affecting the southern states.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University Jagtial
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to blast and bacterial blight
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This fine-grain rice variety is tailored for Telangana and possesses resistance to the two most prevalent rice diseases in the state.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: Dr. Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University Pusa
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Resistant to leaf rust disease
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This wheat variety is specifically adapted to the conditions of Bihar and has resistance to leaf rust a common fungal disease in the region.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Tolerant to downy mildew disease
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This maize hybrid is bred for tolerance to downy mildew a major disease that can cause significant yield losses in the humid conditions of Gujarat during Kharif.

Breeder_Origin_Institution: Keladi Shivappa Nayaka University of Agricultural & Horticultural Sciences Hiriyur
Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Tolerant to leaf spot and rust diseases
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This groundnut variety shows good field tolerance to late leaf spot and rust two major fungal diseases that affect groundnut production in Karnataka.

Stressors_Broadly_Defined: Tolerant to wilt and rust diseases
In_Depth_Stress_Tolerance_Notes: This lentil variety is adapted to the agro-climatic conditions of Rajasthan and has tolerance to both wilt and rust which are key diseases for this crop.
